recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血抹片中，箭頭指出頭盔形細胞（helmet cell）與三角形紅血球碎片（schistocytes），視野中血小板很少，符合 TTP 的微血管病性溶血。
features: Schistocytes including helmet cells and a small triangular fragment (arrows)
Additional red cells with a straight cut edge or irregular contour
Anisocytosis with some larger red cells, likely reticulocytes
Markedly reduced platelets; only a single platelet in the field
Mononuclear cell at the lower left with a folded nucleus and fine cytoplasmic granules
describe_en: High-power peripheral blood smear shows schistocytes, including helmet cells and a small triangular fragment (arrows), along with several red cells bearing straight cut edges. There is anisocytosis with some larger red cells suggestive of reticulocytes, and platelets are markedly decreased, with only a single platelet visible. A mononuclear cell with a folded nucleus is present, and no blasts are seen. Findings are consistent with microangiopathic hemolytic anemia with thrombocytopenia, as seen in thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura.

ddx.vs: DIC shows similar fragments but with prolonged PT/aPTT, hypofibrinogenemia and high D-dimer.
Morphology is identical; renal-predominant disease and ADAMTS13 activity above 10% favor HUS.
Bite cells have a semicircular 'bite' removed from an otherwise intact cell, often with blister cells and Heinz bodies, rather than sharp-cornered helmet and triangular fragments.
